title: State of the CESM
parameterization_target: Warm rain microphysics, ocean vertical mixing (KPP), mesoscale eddies, atmospheric convection, radiation, and air-sea turbulent fluxes
code_availability: Full list of changes at cesm.ucar.edu; citations guidelines provided for model and dataset DOIs; Fortran-to-JAX translation referenced at https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07681
testbed_rationale: This document is a high-level overview workshop presentation summarizing Community Earth System Model updates, projects, and visions rather than a standalone reproducible ML dataset or benchmark.
pain_points: Old and new model biases when introducing new dycores/components
Pathological behaviors (e.g., Labrador Sea freezing issue)
Tuning tradeoffs and high computational cost of full coupled spin-up
Gains achieved through uncoupled PPEs and emulators are typically lost when coupled in the host model
Stability of coupled ML emulators over decadal-to-centennial rollouts
extraction_notes: The presentation is a 'State of the CESM' keynote slide deck delivered by David Lawrence at the CESM Workshop. It highlights ongoing collaborations with LEAP and M2LInES to develop CESM3-MLe (ML-enhanced CESM), coupled emulators (CAMulator, MOMulator via CREDIT), and automated parameter calibration.
